content:
The lower half of the disk has central angle

\[
180^\circ.
\]

It is divided into the angles \(30^\circ\), \(65^\circ\), \(40^\circ\), and the shaded sector angle \(\theta\). Thus,

\[
\theta=180^\circ-30^\circ-65^\circ-40^\circ=45^\circ.
\]

For a point chosen uniformly in a disk, the probability of landing in a sector equals the ratio of its central angle to \(360^\circ\):

\[
P=\frac{45^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac18.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac18}
\]
